about_the_game:
This is your story to tell.

​Arcadian Days is a first-person exploration-adventure game where you guide Miela, a curious young girl, and her loyal dog, Tola, through a vibrant, ever-changing world. Your choices shape a dynamic narrative, influencing relationships, uncovering secrets, and ensuring each journey is uniquely yours. Experience a heartfelt exploration of innocence and discovery as you shape Miela's week.

Stories That Unfold Naturally

Arcadian Days offers an organic narrative experience that unfolds through your interactions and observations within the game world:​

  • Emergent Storytelling: Engage in naturally arising narratives shaped by your actions and discoveries, ensuring each playthrough is uniquely personal.​

  • Interactive Family Dynamics: Deepen your relationship with the Dragobete family through meaningful, interactive experiences that evolve organically based on your choices.​

  • Environmental Story Cues: Notice subtle changes in the landscape and environmental details that hint at unfolding stories, encouraging exploration and engagement.​

With hundreds of narrative possibilities, each playthrough will be unique to you. These are your memories to hold.

Discover a first-of-its-kind world.

​Embark on a journey through the meticulously crafted world of Arcadian Days, where every detail invites exploration and discovery:

  • Dynamic Biomes: Traverse five distinct biomes - from a lush forest, expansive hills and climb up towards a fantastic fortress on a step hill - that evolve daily, influenced by both the passage of time and your choices, ensuring a unique experience with each playthrough.​

  • Cultural Immersion: Engage with the Dragobete family, uncovering their unique customs, traditions, and language, offering an authentic glimpse into their way of life.​

  • Intentional Design: Explore densely populated maps where every element is purposefully placed, promising stunning visuals and secrets awaiting your discovery at every turn.

Explore at Your Own Pace

No hard quests. No combat. No handholding. Just you, your dog Tola, and a world full of secrets waiting to be uncovered through curiosity, attention, and play.

Childlike Interactions, Big Emotional Impact

Whistle for your dog, stack stones, collect found objects, or lie in the grass and watch the clouds pass. Simple, tactile actions that reflect a child's view of the world—creative, emotional, and free.

Immersive Visuals and Sound, Built in Unreal Engine 5

​Arcadian Days harnesses the power of Unreal Engine 5 to deliver an immersive experience that blends rich environmental detail with a dreamy, painterly art style. The ambient sound design and serene soundtrack further enhance the atmosphere, enveloping players in a world that feels both alive and comforting.

Embark on a journey that celebrates curiosity, friendship, and the simple joys of life. Arcadian Days is more than a game; it's an invitation to explore a world filled with wonder and heart.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit required) with DirectX 12
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2050 / AMD RX 6000 / Intel® Arc™ A550 Graphics Card
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: Arcadian Days is an open-world adventure game where your choices shape a dynamic narrative. Explore vibrant landscapes, form meaningful relationships, and uncover secrets with your loyal dog, Tola, ensuring each journey is uniquely yours.
